name: Deployment Verification
description: Post-deployment verification process. Health checks, smoke tests, and regression checks to confirm a deployment is working correctly. This process is READ-ONLY — it verifies and reports but NEVER fixes issues or modifies systems.
narrative: Verification confirms a deployment is healthy; it never fixes what it finds. Check three things in order: that the thing is actually running (health), that its core functions work (a smoke test of the primary paths), and that nothing that used to work broke (regression). Report a clear pass or fail with the evidence for each. If something is wrong, that is a finding for someone else to act on — verification stays read-only, so a broken check becomes a report, not a repair.
